mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student (student_id, student_name, birth, gender, school, address, address_detail, app_id, app_password, created_at, center_code, grade_key, status_key, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{appId}, #{appPassword}, SYSDATETIME(), #{centerCode}, #{gradeKey}, #{statusKey}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT (app_id, 1) AS INT)) AS maxSuffix FROM erp_student WHERE app_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

SELECT s.* , g.* , reg.registeredClassTypes AS classType , pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last as phone
FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_parent pa ON s.student_id = pa.student_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + cc.class_type FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_time_table t ON tta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE tta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} FOR XML PATH ('') , TYPE ).value('.' , 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1 , 1 , '') AS registeredClassTypes ) reg WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (reg.registeredClassTypes IS NULL OR reg.registeredClassTypes IN ('1' , '2' , '3')) AND s.status_key = 'ACTIVE' AND ( ta.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR ta.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} OR (ta.assign_han_teacher IS NULL AND ta.assign_book_teacher IS NULL) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ta.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR ta.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , s.student_name;

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, p.parent_tel_first + p.parent_tel_middle + p.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone, p.relation_key AS parentRelation, s.school AS school, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, s.gender AS genderKey, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail from erp_student s LEFT JOIN erp_status_code sc ON s.status_key = sc.status_key JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON s.grade_key = gc.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key JOIN erp_parent p ON s.student_id = p.student_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ta.han_state AS hanState, ta.book_state AS bookState, ta.han_material_fee AS hanMaterialPrice, ta.book_material_fee AS bookMaterialPrice, ta.assign_han_class AS hanClassKey, ta.assign_book_class AS bookClassKey, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, hc.class_name AS hanClassName, bc.class_name AS bookClassName, hf.fee AS hanFee, bf.fee AS bookFee, ta.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, ta.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate FROM erp_teacher_assign ta JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map hf ON ta.assign_han_class = hf.class_key AND s.center_code = hf.center_code LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map bf ON ta.assign_book_class = bf.class_key AND s.center_code = bf.center_code WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, CASE WHEN s.app_token IS NOT NULL AND s.app_token != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasApp, sc.status_name AS statusName, FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName, s.app_id AS appId, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu on ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu on ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign eta on s.student_id = eta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc on eta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc on eta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key
WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ISNULL(s.status_key, '') < > 'WITHDRAWN' AND ((#{userCode} = 'all' OR hu.user_code = #{userCode} OR bu.user_code = #{userCode}) OR ((ta.han_state is null or ta.han_state = 0) AND (ta.book_state is null or ta.book_state = 0)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN sc.status_name IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN sc.status_name = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN sc.status_name = 'PAUSE' THEN 2 WHEN sc.status_name = 'CANCELED' THEN 3 WHEN sc.status_name = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, s.student_name

SELECT s.id AS id, s.student_id AS studentId, CASE WHEN s.app_token IS NOT NULL AND s.app_token != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasApp, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName, s.app_id AS appId,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = CASE WHEN t2.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta2.class_key ELSE t2.class_key END WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1 AND t2.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cc.class_key = t.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = 2 AND t.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key
t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
ORDER BY s.status, s.student_name
SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN ERP_STATUS_CODE sc on s.status_key = sc.status_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_student SET student_name = #{studentName}, birth = #{birth}, school = #{school}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, grade_key = #{gradeKey}, gender = #{genderKey}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() where student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_parent SET parent_tel_first = #{first}, parent_tel_middle = #{middle}, parent_tel_last = #{last}, relation_key = #{relationKey}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() where student_id = #{studentId}

UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET entry_han_date = #{entryHanDate}, entry_book_date = #{entryBookDate}, han_material_fee = #{hanMaterialFee}, book_material_fee = #{bookMaterialFee}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET han_state = 1, entry_han_date = #{entryHanDate}, inactive_han_date = NULL, inactive_han_reason = NULL, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET han_state = 0, inactive_han_date = #{inactiveHanDate}, inactive_han_reason = #{inactiveHanReason}, assign_han_class = NULL, assign_han_teacher = NULL, han_material_fee = NULL, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET book_state = 1, entry_book_date = #{entryBookDate}, inactive_book_date = NULL, inactive_book_reason = NULL, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET book_state = 0, inactive_book_date = #{inactiveBookDate}, inactive_book_reason = #{inactiveBookReason}, assign_book_class = NULL, assign_book_teacher = NULL, book_material_fee = NULL, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ERP_TEACHER_ASSIGN (student_id, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, assign_han_teacher, assign_book_teacher, han_state, book_state, assign_han_class, assign_book_class) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, #{assignHanTeacher.userCode}, #{assignBookTeacher.userCode}, #{hanState}, #{bookState}, #{assignHanClass.classKey}, #{assignBookClass.classKey})
mapper.update:
UPDATE ERP_TEACHER_ASSIGN
han_state = #{hanState}, assign_han_teacher = #{hanTeacher}, entry_han_date = #{hanEntryDate}, assign_han_class = #{hanClass},
book_state = #{bookState}, assign_book_teacher = #{bookTeacher}, entry_book_date = #{bookEntryDate}, assign_book_class = #{bookClass},
WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, g.grade_name, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, (SELECT MAX(sth.move_at) FROM erp_student_transfer_history sth WHERE sth.student_id = s.student_id) AS moveAt, pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS phone, s.created_at FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_parent pa ON s.student_id = pa.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (#{userCode} = 'all' OR hu.user_code = #{userCode}or bu.user_code = #{userCode}) AND (ta.han_state = 1 or ta.book_state = 1) order by s.student_name asc;

choose.when: UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET assign_han_teacher = #{userCode}, assign_han_class = null, han_material_fee = 0 WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_teacher_assign SET assign_book_teacher = #{userCode}, assign_book_class = null, book_material_fee = 0 WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_transfer_schedule (student_id, class_type, from_user, to_user, move_at, status, reason, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classType}, #{fromUser}, #{toUser}, #{moveAt}, 'SCHEDULED', #{reason}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM erp_student_transfer_schedule WHERE move_at = #{today} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_student_transfer_schedule SET status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_transfer_history (student_id, from_user_code, to_user_code, class_type, transfer_reason, class_key, move_at, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{fromUser.userCode}, #{toUser.userCode}, #{classType}, #{transferReason}, #{classCode.classKey}, #{moveAt}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT center_code as centerCode, student_id as stuid, student_name as name, app_token as token FROM erp_student WHERE app_id = #{appId}

SELECT MAX(t.start_time) AS startTime, MAX(t.end_time) AS endTime, esa.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, t.dayname AS dayname, t.period_no AS periodNo FROM erp_student_attendance esa JOIN erp_time_table t ON esa.time_table_key = t.time_table_key WHERE esa.student_id = #{studentId} AND esa.yy = #{year} AND esa.mm = #{month} GROUP BY esa.time_table_key, t.dayname, t.period_no ORDER BY t.period_no
SELECT in_time, out_time, attendance_date, student_id, attendance_key FROM erp_student_attendance WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE TO_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE FROM_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name as studentName, s.app_password as password, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, s.grade_key as gradeKey, s.app_id as appId, s.app_password as appPassword, s.grade_key as ihak FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE s.app_id = #{appId}

SELECT s.student_id as stuid, s.student_name as name, c.center_code as cid, c.center_name as cname, 'Y' as brotherGb, ss.sibling_key as sibling, s.grade_key as hak, ISNULL(s.profile_img, '1') as profileimg, s.app_id as appId FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code JOIN erp_sibling ss ON s.student_id = ss.student_id WHERE ss.sibling_key = #{siblingKey}

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(cc.class_type AS INT)) = 2 THEN s.grade_key ELSE '00' END AS book_code FROM erp_time_table t inner JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = ta.student_id inner JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY s.grade_key

SELECT CASE t.dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN ecw.mon WHEN 'tue' THEN ecw.tue WHEN 'wed' THEN ecw.wed WHEN 'thu' THEN ecw.thu WHEN 'fri' THEN ecw.fri WHEN 'sat' THEN ecw.sat WHEN 'sun' THEN ecw.sun END AS ymd, t.dayname, ISNULL(sa.in_time, '') AS stime, ISNULL(sa.out_time, '') AS etime, t.start_time AS plannedStime, t.end_time AS plannedEtime, sa.week, '수업' AS gb FROM erp_student_attendance sa JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = sa.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON sa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_class_week ecw ON ecw.week = sa.week AND ecw.center_code = s.center_code AND ecw.year = #{yy} AND ecw.month = #{mm} WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.yy = #{yy} AND sa.mm = #{mm} ORDER BY sa.week

SELECT TOP 1 sa.attendance_date AS ymd, CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 1 THEN '일요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 2 THEN '월요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 3 THEN '화요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 4 THEN '수요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 5 THEN '목요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 6 THEN '금요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 7 THEN '토요일' END AS dayname, REPLACE(sa.in_time, ':', '') AS stime, REPLACE(ISNULL(sa.out_time, ''), ':', '') AS etime, '수업' AS gb FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.in_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.attendance_date DESC, sa.check_in_updated_at DESC
